Superset of AUTHOR_EXAMPLES_2026-09-15.json: every field of that file is copied through unchanged; this file adds proper_entry / marked_by / stop / target / branch on the action that is the trade, per the user instruction of 2026-09-17 (replay matches ENTRIES, not stops or targets).

clock_conventions.ninjatrader_2026: UK local time as printed; subtract 5 hours in British Summer Time to get ET
clock_conventions.tradingview: footer UTC-4 or UTC-5 as printed

fields.levels: prices the author drew before or at the trade, as read from the chart
fields.actions: printed fills, resting orders and position-tool boxes; qty in contracts of the stated instrument; times ET
fields.expected_detection: what B0.2 must find for the example to count as detected: branch, side, reference level and the entry window; a miss is a finding, never a reason to change a rule without a source quote
fields.proper_entry: true on the action that IS the trade: for Green Bird the entry marked with the TradingView risk-reward tool (entry line, red stop box, green target box); for Jumbo the fill the post narrates as the trade. Other fills on the same chart are scalps or attempts and are neither detections nor misses.
fields.reference_price: the drawn level the entry was taken at, used for matching when the post narrates a trade without printing a fill price
